Name: Supabase - Run Migrations
Description:
Runs database migrations against a Supabase project using the Supabase CLI.

This step will:
1. Install the Supabase CLI if not already present
2. Authenticate with Supabase using the access token
3. Push pending migrations to the remote database

**Prerequisites:**
- An existing Supabase project
- Database migrations defined in your project's `migrations/` directory

**Finding your Project Ref:**
- From the Supabase Dashboard URL: `https://app.supabase.com/project/<PROJECT_REF>/...`
- Or go to **Project Settings → General**

[Supabase CLI Documentation](https://supabase.com/docs/reference/cli/introduction)
[Database Migrations Guide](https://supabase.com/docs/guides/migrations)

Properties.Octopus.Action.Script.ScriptBody:
# Supabase - Run Migrations
# This script runs database migrations against a Supabase project

set -e

# Export Octopus variables as environment variables
export SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF="#{SupabaseProjectRef}"
export SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD="#{SupabaseDbPassword}"
export SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN="#{SupabaseAccessToken}"
export SUPABASE_CLI_VERSION="#{SupabaseCliVersion}"

# Parameter validation
if [ -z "$SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: Supabase Project Ref is required. Please provide a value for 'Project Ref'."
    exit 1
fi

if [ -z "$SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: Database Password is required. Please provide a value for 'Database Password'."
    exit 1
fi

if [ -z "$SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: Access Token is required. Please provide a value for 'Access Token'."
    exit 1
fi

echo "=========================================="
echo "Supabase - Run Migrations"
echo "=========================================="
echo "Project Ref: $SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF"
echo "CLI Version: $SUPABASE_CLI_VERSION"
echo "=========================================="

# Check if Supabase CLI is installed
install_supabase_cli() {
    local version="$1"
    
    echo "Installing Supabase CLI..."
    
    # Detect OS
    if [ "$(uname)" = "Darwin" ]; then
        # macOS
        if [ "$version" = "latest" ]; then
            brew install supabase/tap/supabase
        else
            brew install supabase/tap/supabase@"$version"
        fi
    elif [ "$(uname)" = "Linux" ]; then
        # Linux - install via npm
        if [ "$version" = "latest" ]; then
            npm install -g supabase
        else
            npm install -g supabase@"$version"
        fi
    else
        echo "ERROR: Unsupported operating system: $(uname)"
        exit 1
    fi
}

# Check for CLI
if ! command -v supabase &> /dev/null; then
    echo "Supabase CLI not found. Installing..."
    install_supabase_cli "$SUPABASE_CLI_VERSION"
else
    echo "Supabase CLI found: $(which supabase)"
    CURRENT_VERSION=$(supabase --version 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $2}')
    echo "Current version: $CURRENT_VERSION"
    
    # Optionally update if not latest
    if [ "$SUPABASE_CLI_VERSION" != "latest" ] && [ "$SUPABASE_CLI_VERSION" != "$CURRENT_VERSION" ]; then
        echo "Updating CLI to version $SUPABASE_CLI_VERSION..."
        install_supabase_cli "$SUPABASE_CLI_VERSION"
    fi
fi

# Verify CLI installation
if ! command -v supabase &> /dev/null; then
    echo "ERROR: Failed to install Supabase CLI"
    exit 1
fi

echo ""
echo "=========================================="
echo "Authenticating with Supabase..."
echo "=========================================="

# Set access token for CLI
echo "$SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN" | supabase login --token stdin

# Link the project
echo "Linking Supabase project..."
supabase link --project-ref "$SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF"

# Run migrations
echo ""
echo "=========================================="
echo "Running database migrations..."
echo "=========================================="

# Push migrations to the remote database
# The CLI will use the access token for authentication
export PGPASSWORD="$SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD"

supabase db push \
    --db-password "$SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD" \
    --linked

echo ""
echo "=========================================="
echo "Migration completed successfully!"
echo "=========================================="

Parameters.Name: SupabaseProjectRef
Parameters.Label: Project Ref
Parameters.HelpText:
The unique identifier of your Supabase project.

**Where to find it:**
- From your project URL: `https://app.supabase.com/project/<PROJECT_REF>/settings/general`
- In Dashboard: **Project Settings → General → Project ID**

Example: `abcdefghijklmn`

Parameters.Name: SupabaseDbPassword
Parameters.Label: Database Password
Parameters.HelpText:
The password for the PostgreSQL database user (postgres).

**Where to find it:**
- In Supabase Dashboard: **Project Settings → Database → Database password**
- Note: This is the initial password set when creating the project

This value is stored securely and will not be displayed in logs.

Parameters.Name: SupabaseAccessToken
Parameters.Label: Access Token
Parameters.HelpText:
Your Supabase access token for CLI authentication.

**Where to get it:**
1. Go to [Supabase Dashboard → Account](https://app.supabase.com/account)
2. Click **Access Tokens**
3. Create a new token or use an existing one

This value is stored securely and will not be displayed in logs.

Parameters.Name: SupabaseCliVersion
Parameters.Label: CLI Version
Parameters.HelpText:
The version of the Supabase CLI to install.

- Use `latest` to always use the newest version
- Specify a version like `1.123.4` for a specific version

Default: `latest`
